_: Editorial choices for the feed mockups. keep = the reason as shown: one verbatim span of the AI's WHY line (calls.csv), a trailing ' …' marks a cut. hl = the one clause highlighted, verbatim inside keep. plain = OUR reading, shown only under a label that says so. why = why that clause. run.js refuses to build if keep or hl is not verbatim.

GPT.keep: Higher QuickBooks renewal prices and stronger October sales at small firms should lift subscription and payment revenue.
GPT.hl: stronger October sales at small firms
GPT.why: GPT itself calls the October sales its stronger signal; the price rise is the known part

Claude.keep: Intuit's own guide says growth slows again tonight, its last two slower quarters were sold, and app software keeps falling.
Claude.hl: its last two slower quarters were sold
Claude.why: the pattern Claude bets on (slower quarters get sold); the other two clauses are context
Claude.cut: drops the lead 'Short, small:' the side badge already says

Grok.keep: Heavy washout and AI-disruption overhang leave residual owned slower-growth story as confirmation; beat unlikely to re-anchor ownership before next close.
Grok.hl: beat unlikely to re-anchor ownership before next close
Grok.why: the decision: even a beat will not bring buyers back by the close
Grok.plain: Intuit has already been sold hard on fears that AI will hurt it. Grok expects the report to confirm slower growth, and doubts even a beat brings buyers back before the next close.

Gemini.keep: Down 52% YTD to 15x earnings with EPS estimates already cut 34% …
Gemini.why: the bar is already low; the rest of the line is hidden in the screenshot ('[hidden]f bounce'), so it is cut
Gemini.cut: the clause after the semicolon is cut: one word is hidden in the screenshot

Qwen.keep: Priced for AI ruin at 13x. Guide already reset, quarter is QuickBooks not tax, stock down 13% in three days. Relief bounce beats fear.
Qwen.why: the reason under the long: the price already assumes the worst (the research's own pick for the teaser)

GPT.keep: Test gear orders ran ahead of shipments. I expect Keysight to guide January-quarter sales above $2 billion.
GPT.hl: I expect Keysight to guide January-quarter sales above $2 billion.
GPT.why: the one testable prediction the long rests on

Claude.keep: Keysight is 26% off its high with its AI-test peers, keeps beating its own guide, and took in more orders than it shipped.
Claude.hl: took in more orders than it shipped
Claude.why: demand ahead of supply is what makes the long; the drawdown and the beats are setup

Grok.keep: Residual owned AI test-demand story maps solid print as confirmation; washout not deep enough to re-anchor ownership before next close.
Grok.hl: washout not deep enough to re-anchor ownership before next close
Grok.why: the decision: the stock has not fallen far enough for new buyers
Grok.plain: Investors already own Keysight's AI test-gear story, so a solid report only confirms it, and the stock has not fallen far enough to pull in new buyers before the next close.

Gemini.keep: Supply constraints capping FY27 revenue conversion clash with 82% Buy ratings and a broken chart, echoing August's post-earnings drop.
Gemini.hl: Supply constraints capping FY27 revenue conversion
Gemini.why: the fundamental reason for the short; the ratings, the chart and August are supporting

Qwen.keep: Orders up 56% and record backlog, yet the Street models only 15% growth next year. Stock already down 26%; the bar is low tonight.
Qwen.hl: the Street models only 15% growth next year
Qwen.why: the gap between orders and the forecast is the whole case

GPT.keep: Annual cloud sales grew 27% and more customers signed six-figure contracts. I expect Elastic to raise its subscription forecast.
GPT.hl: I expect Elastic to raise its subscription forecast.
GPT.why: the prediction the long rests on

Claude.keep: Elastic fell 27% in three weeks and 7% today on no news, while its contracted backlog growth has risen four quarters running.
Claude.hl: its contracted backlog growth has risen four quarters running
Claude.why: the fundamental against the fall; Claude's thesis says the stock rose when it reached 20%

Grok.keep: Lower residual ownership of search-AI growth plus last-print upside digestion leaves room for better-than-feared AI adoption to drive positive close.
Grok.hl: better-than-feared AI adoption to drive positive close
Grok.plain: Few investors still own Elastic's AI search story, and the stock has already digested its rise after the last report, so better-than-feared AI demand could lift it by the next close.

Gemini.keep: Broad software selloff dragged ESTC back to its pre-Q1 price despite four straight beats and real AI search momentum.
Gemini.hl: despite four straight beats and real AI search momentum
Gemini.why: the mismatch the long rests on: the business did well and the stock did not

Qwen.keep: Market grades Elastic on subscription acceleration, not beats. Whisper sits above guidance and Datadog just guided consumption flat.
Qwen.hl: Market grades Elastic on subscription acceleration, not beats.
Qwen.why: the short's whole thesis, and it answers Gemini's 'four straight beats' head on
